occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: During the monitoring inspection, the director file was viewed and did not have their health and safety trainings for calendar year 2025-2026 available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: During the monitoring inspection, five out of ten staff files viewed did not have their health and safety trainings for calendar year 2025-2026 available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: During the inspection, the operational policy was viewed and the following information was missing:  (9)Safe sleep policy for infants from birth through 12 months old that is consistent  with the rules in subchapter H of this chapter (relating to Basic Requirements for  Infants) that relate to sleep requirements and restrictions, including sleep  positioning, and crib requirements and restrictions, including mattresses,  bedding, blankets, toys, and restrictive devices; (22) Procedures for parents to participate in the child-care center's operation and activities; (23) Instructions on how a parent may access the (A) Minimum standards online;  (B) Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline; and (C) HHSC website.  During the inspection, the operational policy was viewed and the following information was missing:   (25) Your provisions to provide a comfortable place with an adult sized seat in your center or within a classroom that enables a mother to breastfeed her child. In addition, your policies must inform parents that they have the right to breastfeed or provide breast milk for their child while in care.  (30) (b)You must also inform the parents that any area within 1,000 feet of a child-care center is a   gang-free zone, where criminal offenses related to organized criminal activity are subject to a   harsher penalty under the Texas Penal Code. You may inform the parents by:  (A) Providing this information in the operational policies;  (B) Distributing the information in writing to the parents; or  (C) Informing the parents verbally as part of an individual or group parent orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: Operation people list has not been validated since 10-17-2024.    Note: This was corrected at inspection.
